content.outro: The hearth stands cold and open, and the keeper's hall is quiet.
content.premise: The keeper's hall at Ashby has a great hearth whose fire has burned since the keeper's grandfather lit it. A valve on the hall's wall floods the flue, and the keeper has sent for someone to turn it at last.
content.theme: A stone hall with a great hearth in its north wall and a valve beside it; the hearth's brick back hides what is behind it until the valve puts the fire out.
content.title: A Hidden Way
